title: Update 'Managing Nested Groups' page regarding Internal vs External groups
description: {panel:bgColor=#e7f4fa}   *NOTE:* This suggestion is for *JIRA Server*. Using *JIRA Cloud*? [See the corresponding suggestion|http://jira.atlassian.com/browse/JRACLOUD-32948].   {panel}  Currently we cannot use nested groups between Internal and External groups.  We have a bug already created ([JRA-24671|https://jira.atlassian.com/browse/JRA-24671]) for this, but there nothing mentioning this restriction in the [documentation|https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA/Managing+Nested+Groups]    It would avoid a lot of issues if this information was explicit there  * [Managing Nested Groups|https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA/Managing+Nested+Groups]
